findings.finding: RunResult.code is optional (code?: number | null) but the uv-managed-Python fallback depends on it (readiness-probe.ts uvPy.code === 0). A custom RunFn seam that omits code silently disables the uv-managed acceptance path — a false NEGATIVE (python shows not-ready even when uv could provide 3.11+). Fails toward not-ready (the safe direction for a gate), so not a defect today; the optionality is a deliberate compat choice for existing mock RunFns.
findings.suggestion: No change required now (fail-safe direction). If a future importer relies on the fallback via an injected run, tighten to code: number | null once all mock seams set it.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: readiness probe latency is bounded by the slowest single probe — resolvePython runs python3->python->py sequentially inside the Promise.all branch; if two python probes hang to the 8s timeout the python arm is ~16-24s, so the first uncached GET /api/readiness can take ~3x the documented bound. NOT a correctness bug: execFile is async (event loop never blocked), result cached 15s, each probe timeout-capped, mirrors preflight.mjs. Only the doc comment was imprecise.
